title: Front end developer | Immediate Joiner | Remote
description: This is a remote position. About The Role We are looking for a high-level Front-End Developer who views web development as an art form. You aren’t just a coder; you are a bridge between sophisticated design and high-performance engineering. As a member of our team, you will lead the charge in optimizing our React ecosystem, exploring new plugins, and ensuring seamless API integrations. Key Responsibilities Design-to-Code Mastery: Expertly translate high-fidelity Figma designs into clean, semantic, and modular code. Architecture & Scaling: Develop and maintain complex web applications using React.js, focusing on state management and performance optimization. Cross-Framework Versatility: While React is our core, your ability to navigate or migrate Angular environments is a significant plus. Full-Stack Integration: Collaborate with backend teams to integrate RESTful/GraphQL APIs and ensure end-to-end data integrity. Tooling & Extensions: Implement and build custom React plugins/extensions to enhance the development workflow. Version Control: Manage complex branching, merging, and code reviews via Git. Our Selection Process We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient hiring cycle. Round 1: Practical Code Assessment : A real-world challenge focusing on Figma translation and React logic. Round 2: Technical Deep Dive : A conversation with our Engineering Leads covering architecture, performance, and problem-solving. Round 3: Final HR Interview : Discussion regarding culture fit, expectations, and immediate onboarding. Requirements Technical Requirements Core Tech: 3-4+ years of experience with React.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Styled Components, or SASS). Design Tools: Mastery of Figma (including Auto Layout, Components, and Prototyping). State Management: Deep knowledge of Redux, Context API, or Zustand. The "Plus" Factor: Proficiency in other front-end frameworks and a solid understanding of Node.js for backend collaboration. Modern Workflow: Experience with Webpack/Vite, Unit Testing (Jest/Cypress), and CI/CD pipelines. Benefits Why Join Us? Opportunity to work on cutting-edge products. Fast-paced, high-growth environment. Immediate Onboarding: We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running within [2 weeks/immediately].

title: SDE-2
description: SDE - 2 Join us as a Software Development Engineer in our BT Development team at our Goa office to get the opportunity to do the best work of your career and make a profound impact in our journey of enabling retail in India. What You’ll Achieve As a Software Developer in our BT Development team in our Goa office, you will be working on (CakePHP/ Laravel, Yii/ Phalcon) and would have an opportunity to work with a leading retail software solutions company. You Will Collaborate with the product team to provide technical expertise on requirements. Contribute significantly to the execution of the product roadmap by designing and implementing scalable backend modules and intuitive frontend components. Take ownership of small to mid-sized modules and features and drive them from design to delivery. Write high-performance and maintainable code – we run ~5 million API jobs/day, so performance is the key. Review code written by peers and provide constructive feedback to ensure high code quality and consistency. Plan and automate test scenarios in collaboration with the QA team. Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of modules and services being built. Participate in capacity planning and system optimization efforts as we scale. Work in Agile methodologies – daily standups, weekly sprints, and retrospectives will be part of your routine. Take this next step in your career with a steep learning curve and real ownership from day one. Every Ginesys team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: Essential Requirements Must have 2–5 years of experience in backend development using any one PHP 5+ framework (CakePHP/ Laravel/ Yii/ Phalcon). Solid experience with MySQL and good understanding of relational databases. Hands-on experience with Angular.js or React.js or Vue.js. Strong knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3 for responsive web development. Experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs. Desirable Requirements Exposure to Git/Jenkins or any other CI/CD tools. Knowledge of AWS/Azure infrastructure services. Working knowledge of Redis, Elasticsearch, or NoSQL databases. Familiarity with secondary programming languages such as Python or Node.js. Experience with performance profiling and optimization techniques. Benefits We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as: Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more! Here’s our story; now tell us yours “Ginesys One” is India’s best omniretail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200+ brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionise retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys’ core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

description: Position: Embedded Software Engineer Experience: 3-5 Years No.of Openings: 1 Job Location: Panjim, Goa Salary: Best in Industry Notice Period: Immediate joiners will be preferred Education: Degree – BE / B.Tech / ME / MTech. Requirements Responsibilities and Duties Design and implement embedded software solutions from requirements gathering through to production and commercial deployment. Develop, code, test, and debug system-level and application-level embedded software. Build firmware for power electronics systems in the power generation domain. Develop and optimize MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) and PWM inverter/optimizer algorithms. Work with embedded development boards such as ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and ARM-based systems. Perform low-level driver development, including ADC and peripheral integration. Implement and troubleshoot communication protocols including CAN, SPI, I2C, and UART. Contribute to AC-DC, DC-DC, and DC-AC circuit design and validation. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver efficient designs that meet project requirements and timelines. Develop IoT-related code and integrate API interfaces into embedded platforms. Prepare prototypes, technical documentation, and reports for project stakeholders. Skills and Qualifications Strong experience in embedded system development and full product life cycle involvement. Proficiency in embedded C, MicroPython, and Python programming languages. Proficient in analyzing and interpreting technical datasheets for electronic components. Hands-on expertise in firmware design and development for power electronic devices. Knowledge of IoT development, API integration, , connection protocols and cloud integration. In-depth understanding of control systems and algorithm implementation. Familiarity with microcontrollers such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, and PIC families. Working knowledge of power electronics circuit design (AC-DC, DC-DC, DC-AC). Experience with hardware–software integration, debugging, and validation. Designed and deployed backend services to collect and aggregate high-volume data streams from diverse sources Ability to identify creative design solutions and present them effectively to team members and project managers. Ability to learn and implement new technologies as per business needs. Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and collaborative approach. Excellent communication skills for cross-functional teamwork and documentation. Preferred Qualifications Bachelors or Masters in Electronics and Electrical.
